easy.def: Feeling upset because someone has something you want.
easy.example: I felt jealous of her new bike.

more.def: Unhappy because you want what another person has.
more.example: He felt jealous when his friend won the prize.

easy.example: The journey to Grandma's house takes all day.

more.def: A trip from one place to another, usually a long one.
more.example: The explorers began their journey across the frozen land.

easy.def: A hot place with lots of trees and plants.

more.def: A thick forest in a hot, rainy part of the world.
more.example: Bright parrots flew through the jungle.

easy.example: Justice means the rules are fair for all.

more.def: Fair treatment for everyone, following what is right.
more.example: The judge worked hard to make sure there was justice.
